summary: Verified Rate Service modal on web_panel (customer, mobile viewport 390x844). Logged in as +919000000004 / OTP 123456, clicked rate-service-btn, modal opened. Confirmed tip/thank-you UI is fully removed (no thank-you-card, tip-20, tip-50, tip-100 testids and no 'Say thanks with a tip' or any 'tip' word in the modal). All required testids present (rate-modal-service, rate-star-1..5, rate-star-label, rate-comment, rate-later-btn, rate-submit-btn, rate-modal-close). Rated 5 stars (label 'Excellent'), added a comment, submit succeeded (POST /api/bookings/{id}/review 200), toast 'Thanks for your rating!' shown and modal closed. Keyboard-inset backdrop paddingBottom is 0px when keyboard is closed (no layout regression). Code review of Customer/src/components/customer/RateService.tsx confirmed tip card removed, KeyboardAvoidingView replaced by Keyboard.addListener (keyboardWillShow on iOS / keyboardDidShow on Android) that drives paddingBottom = keyboard height on both the backdrop and the sheet — no TS/runtime issues found; the tip_amount field in the Pending type is still declared but is only a type-level artefact and harmless. Rebuilt /app/web_panel (yarn build) because the previous static /api/panel bundle still contained the old tip markup (tip-20 / thank-you-card / 'Say thanks with a tip'); new bundle is clean.
critical_code_review_comments: Customer/src/components/customer/RateService.tsx still declares tip_amount?: number on the Pending type. Harmless (nothing reads it in the UI anymore) but can be removed for cleanliness.

web_panel static build must be rebuilt whenever RateService.jsx changes — otherwise /api/panel serves stale JS. Consider wiring the rebuild into CI or a supervisor pre-start hook so the main agent does not have to remember to run build_panel.sh.

If RateService.jsx (or any web_panel source) is modified, you MUST run `bash /app/web_panel/build_panel.sh` before UI testing or the old bundle will be served. Login via /api/panel/login with +919000000004 OTP 123456. Pending reviews come from GET /api/bookings/my/pending-reviews; auto_prompt=false in current data so modal is opened by clicking data-testid='rate-service-btn' on home.
rca of the issue: Original bug: Rate modal still showed tip card + comment box was hidden by soft keyboard. Fix shipped by E1: (a) removed tip/thank-you markup from both web_panel RateService.jsx and Customer RateService.tsx; (b) web uses useKeyboardInset() to set paddingBottom on the backdrop equal to window.innerHeight - visualViewport.height, keeping sheet above keyboard; (c) RN uses Keyboard.addListener keyboardWillShow (iOS) / keyboardDidShow (Android) to set paddingBottom = e.endCoordinates.height on backdrop AND sheet. Static panel bundle had to be rebuilt because build was from before the fix.
